user.title: Connect to BabyMonitarr
user.description: Enter the address of your BabyMonitarr backend and an API key created in the BabyMonitarr UI.

data_description.host: Host name or URL of the backend, for example 192.168.1.10:5000 or https://babymonitarr.local
data_description.api_key: A BabyMonitarr API key. No Home Assistant token is stored in BabyMonitarr.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BabyMonitarr
reauth_confirm.description: The BabyMonitarr API key was rejected. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_host: That does not look like a valid host or URL

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single BabyMonitarr backend is supported.

cast_room.name: Cast room
cast_room.description: Starts casting a room to Cast receivers. Without targets the room's saved selection is used.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or id of the BabyMonitarr room to cast.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Cast receivers to start, by name or device id. Omit to use the room's saved targets.

stop_cast.name: Stop cast
stop_cast.description: Stops every cast session for a room.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or id of the BabyMonitarr room to stop casting.

snapshot.name: Snapshot (not supported)
snapshot.description: Not supported by this backend: BabyMonitarr has no still-image capability, so this service always fails with that explanation. The name is reserved for when a still endpoint exists.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or id of the BabyMonitarr room.

webrtc_not_supported.message: This BabyMonitarr backend does not advertise the 'webrtc' feature, so it cannot answer a camera offer.

webrtc_codec_mismatch.message: BabyMonitarr can only forward the codec the camera already produces, and this offer did not list it.

webrtc_failed.message: BabyMonitarr could not negotiate the stream.

webrtc_disconnected.message: The connection to BabyMonitarr was lost.

webrtc_superseded.message: Another Home Assistant session started streaming this camera.
